content.short: The CronosVerse is a social MMO metaverse on Cronos with land ownership and Crovilians.
content.description: The CronosVerse is a metaverse project on the Cronos blockchain, delivering a social MMO gaming experience for the Cronos community. Players participate as land owners or Crovilian civilians, with each Crovilian possessing a unique set of traits that signal its role within CronosVerse society. In addition to the native Crovilian characters, partner projects will have their own Metaverse experiences within CronosVerse Land Tiles. Users can purchase digital land plots and begin developing their property and community.
content.meta: The CronosVerse is a metaverse on Cronos offering a social MMO gaming experience. Discover The CronosVerse and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
